CLASS zcl_zapi_po_http DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             ebelp TYPE ebelp,
             matnr TYPE matnr,
             menge TYPE bstmg,
             wemng TYPE wemng,
             elikz TYPE elikz,
           END OF ty_item,
           ty_item_t TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH DEFAULT KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_po_status,
             ebeln  TYPE ebeln,
             lifnr  TYPE lifnr,
             bukrs  TYPE bukrs,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             items  TYPE ty_item_t,
           END OF ty_po_status,
           BEGIN OF ty_note_req,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_note_req,
           BEGIN OF ty_error,
             error   TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_error.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_po    IMPORTING iv_ebeln TYPE ebeln RETURNING VALUE(rs_po) TYPE ty_po_status RAISING zcx_po_not_found.
    METHODS add_note  IMPORTING iv_ebeln TYPE ebeln is_req TYPE ty_note_req.
    METHODS respond_error IMPORTING io_server TYPE REF TO if_http_server iv_code TYPE i iv_err TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zapi_po_http IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_method) = server->request->get_header_field( '~request_method' ).
    DATA(lv_path)   = server->request->get_header_field( '~path_info' ).
    DATA(lv_with_items) = server->request->get_form_field( 'with_items' ).
    SPLIT lv_path AT '/' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_seg).
    DELETE lt_seg WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
    DATA(lv_ebeln) = CONV ebeln( VALUE string( lt_seg[ 1 ] OPTIONAL ) ).
    IF lv_ebeln NP '++++++++++' OR lv_ebeln CN '0123456789'.
      respond_error( io_server = server iv_code = 400 iv_err = 'INVALID_EBELN' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    CASE lv_method.
      WHEN 'GET'.
        IF lv_path CP '/*'.
          AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'M_BEST_EKO' ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03' ID 'EKORG' DUMMY.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            respond_error( io_server = server iv_code = 403 iv_err = 'NO_AUTH' ).
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          TRY.
              DATA(ls_po) = get_po( lv_ebeln ).
            CATCH zcx_po_not_found.
              respond_error( io_server = server iv_code = 404 iv_err = 'PO_NOT_FOUND' ).
              RETURN.
          ENDTRY.
          server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
          server->response->set_cdata( /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_po pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-low_case ) ).
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'POST'.
        IF lv_path CP '/*/note'.
          AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'M_BEST_EKO' ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '02' ID 'EKORG' DUMMY.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            respond_error( io_server = server iv_code = 403 iv_err = 'NO_AUTH' ).
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          DATA ls_req TYPE ty_note_req.
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = server->request->get_cdata( ) CHANGING data = ls_req ).
          IF ls_req-text IS INITIAL OR strlen( ls_req-text ) > 255.
            respond_error( io_server = server iv_code = 400 iv_err = 'INVALID_TEXT' ).
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          SELECT SINGLE ebeln FROM ekko WHERE ebeln = @lv_ebeln INTO @DATA(lv_exists).
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            respond_error( io_server = server iv_code = 404 iv_err = 'PO_NOT_FOUND' ).
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          add_note( iv_ebeln = lv_ebeln is_req = ls_req ).
          server->response->set_status( code = 201 reason = 'Created' ).
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        server->response->set_status( code = 405 reason = 'Method Not Allowed' ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_po.
    SELECT SINGLE ebeln, lifnr, bukrs, loekz FROM ekko WHERE ebeln = @iv_ebeln INTO @DATA(ls_ekko).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_po_not_found.
    ENDIF.
    rs_po-ebeln = ls_ekko-ebeln. rs_po-lifnr = ls_ekko-lifnr. rs_po-bukrs = ls_ekko-bukrs.
    SELECT p~ebelp, p~matnr, p~menge, p~elikz, SUM( e~wemng ) AS wemng
      FROM ekpo AS p LEFT OUTER JOIN eket AS e ON e~ebeln = p~ebeln AND e~ebelp = p~ebelp
      WHERE p~ebeln = @iv_ebeln
      GROUP BY p~ebelp, p~matnr, p~menge, p~elikz
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rs_po-items.
    IF ls_ekko-loekz = 'L'.
      rs_po-status = 'CLOSED'.
    ELSEIF rs_po-items IS NOT INITIAL AND NOT line_exists( rs_po-items[ elikz = '' ] ).
      rs_po-status = 'DELIVERED'.
    ELSEIF line_exists( rs_po-items[ wemng > 0 ] ) OR line_exists( rs_po-items[ elikz = 'X' ] ).
      rs_po-status = 'PARTIAL'.
    ELSE.
      rs_po-status = 'OPEN'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_note.
    SELECT MAX( seqno ) FROM zpo_note WHERE ebeln = @iv_ebeln INTO @DATA(lv_max).
    DATA(ls_note) = VALUE zpo_note( ebeln = iv_ebeln seqno = lv_max + 1 note_text = is_req-text
                                    ernam = sy-uname erdat = sy-datum erzet = sy-uzeit ).
    INSERT zpo_note FROM @ls_note.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE e012(zmm_bond) INTO DATA(lv_dummy).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD respond_error.
    DATA(ls_err) = VALUE ty_error( error = iv_err message = iv_err ).
    io_server->response->set_status( code = iv_code reason = 'Error' ).
    io_server->response->set_cdata( /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_err pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-low_case ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" ===== LOCAL TEST CLASSES (CCAU) =====
CLASS ltc_po_http DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS status_partial FOR TESTING.
    METHODS invalid_ebeln  FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
